description: Make a model ready in one call: optionally pull it, check it fits current free VRAM, unload other models if needed (evict: 'lru' or 'all'), load it, and verify. Use dryRun:true to get the plan without changing anything.

allowPull.description: Download the model if it is not installed (default false)

contextLength.description: Context window to fit and load with (default 4096)

evict.description: Unload other models to make room: none (default), lru (least recently used first), all

keepAlive.description: Keep-alive for the loaded model, e.g. '30m'

kvCacheType.description: KV cache precision used for the fit estimate (default f16)

provider.description: Provider instance name. Omit to let the server choose (local providers only, unless LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK is set).

name: ensure_model
title: Ensure model is ready
